parsedVerdict.reasoning: The infrastructure module has one concern: HTTP delivery and its composition root. app.ts exports createApp(), which wires up the services and defines the Express routes. index.ts only bootstraps: it calls createApp() and app.listen(PORT). index.ts uses the module's own createApp abstraction and does not reach into services. All route handlers in app.ts go through OrderService and CatalogueService instead of using domain objects directly. Creating the Catalogue inside createApp is normal composition-root wiring. Business invariants such as order transitions and stock checks are left to the application services. The checks in the handlers (items must be a non-empty array, state is required) only validate the request. Minor issues, not enough to fail: the same try/catch that maps errors to a 400 response is repeated in three handlers, sample-data seeding sits inside createApp, and 'state as any' skips type checking. None of these splits the module into unrelated concerns, duplicates a domain invariant, or bypasses the module's abstractions.
